title: Localization of the constructed ordinary tensor restriction square
statement: Let g prime:X prime to X be a scheme morphism and let U,U prime be opens, with j:U prime to U satisfying j followed by the inclusion of U equals the inclusion of U prime followed by g prime. For any cochain complex P of modules on X, localize the inverse of the homotopy tensor restriction isomorphism [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso] at P and compose with the inverse exact restriction localization factor [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. This constructs beta:Q(j* restriction(P)) to restriction(Q(g prime* P)); it requires neither K-flatness nor any chosen representative.

def singleComplexOpenTensorRestrictionMap
    [d : ∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (U : X.Opens) (U' : X'.Opens) (j : U'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ U.ι = U'.ι ≫ g')
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.Modules := d X
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{w} X'.Modules := d X'
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{w} U.toScheme.Modules := d U.toScheme
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{w} U'.toScheme.Modules := d U'.toScheme
    letI : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).Additive := schemeOpenRestriction_additive X U
    letI : (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').Additive := schemeOpenRestriction_additive X' U'
    DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj (((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ⟶
    (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategory.obj
      (DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
